## History

Mrs. Spencer was visited by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after a mistake led to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) being sent to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of a boy. During the visit, Mrs. [Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) offered to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to hesitate and decide to return [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) temporarily before ultimately agreeing to keep her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)_

## Relationships

### [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

[Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) is the child of Mrs. Spencer. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. Spencer to resolve an adoption mix-up, the topic of children and prospective caretakers is discussed in her household context.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), +2 more_
